locked_context.mothers_day: Mother's Day was the prototype and is independently released as planned.
locked_context.core_rule: Holiday promos are not one-off hacks. They rotate through a governed seasonal system.
locked_context.release_rule: BIC-level release = production audit pass, not local build pass.

rotation_layers.purpose: Direct holiday buyer demand windows such as Father's Day, Mother's Day, Valentine's Day, Christmas, Thanksgiving.
rotation_layers.rule: Use holiday-specific entry points only during relevant buyer windows. Avoid direct same-holiday LT-PIX unless explicitly cleared.

rotation_layers.purpose: Between holiday windows, promote broader contemporary seasonal emotions.
rotation_layers.rule: Calendar seasons are traditional enough for buyers to understand, but copy and matching should feel contemporary, evolving, and emotionally specific.

rotation_layers.purpose: Always-on buyer needs that should never disappear.
rotation_layers.rule: Evergreen pages stay active while holiday and season features rotate above them.

rotation_layers.purpose: Prevent the same few IIs from dominating every route.
rotation_layers.rule: Search-to-Match has no hard limit, but weekly rotation should expose all qualified tracks/IIs over time when helpful.

candidate_laws: No INSTRO / instrumental-only K-KUT buyer delivery.
No direct same-holiday LT-PIX by default.
No Music Maykers in public UI.
No mKs / mini-KUTs in public buyer flow unless ADMIN override is active.
No duplicate II unless ADMIN explicitly directs it.
Customer delivery audio requires padding + Twinkle together.

metadata_policy.pix_metadata: PIX labels and source metadata are useful but partial.
metadata_policy.kk_metadata: KK labels must carry most buyer-match weight and must be robust.

current_priority.reason: Upcoming revenue window and previously identified candidate pool.
current_priority.next_required_state: strict Father’s Day candidate records with real deliverable audio candidates, then padding + Twinkle materialization, then BIC production audit.
